descriptor: Gift shop with a recommendation quiz

voice.summary: Giftwise sounds like the friend who always picks the right present: warm, observant and quietly funny. It asks gentle questions and explains why each gift fits.
dos: Ask about the person, not the product
Give a reason with every recommendation
Show the price early and honestly
donts: Do not use cheesy gift-guide phrases
Avoid pushing the most expensive match
Never imply a gift is wrong

taglines: Tell us who, we will find what
A better present in five questions
boilerplate: Giftwise is an online gift shop with a short quiz about the recipient, occasion, budget and style that ranks gifts by how well they match and explains why.

microcopy.error: Could not save that gift. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: Nothing matches yet. Try loosening a filter.

logo.note: A diamond hints at a gift and a precious choice, in a shape that scales well.
